issue: gʷréwōm is GEN.PL of gʷéru; object of widónt 'they found spears' needs ACC.PL gʷéruh₂. (Also ph₂stā́m zero-grade for imperfective 'were guarding' – minor.)
h₁ím h₂ewsér wédʰet 'led ... to him': goal person in ACC; dative h₁ésmey expected.
h₁égʷʰis kréwh₂s 'the blood of the serpent': wrong grade and case; GEN.SG h₁ógʷʰeys required.
só ... poh₂imḗn bʰúHm̥ 'that one became his herdsman': bʰúHm̥ is 1sg; 3sg bʰúHt required.
kʷóti gʷṓs h₂éǵete / h₂éǵome present for English past 'did you drive / we drove'.
h₂l̥gʷʰént (h₂elgʷʰ- 'be worth, fetch a price') rendered 'brought them in' – stretched sense.
h₂élgʷʰt (h₂elgʷʰ- 'be worth') rendered 'brought in many cows' – stretched sense.
h₂mélǵos-kʷe sweh₂déwih₂m: predicate adj is ACC.SG fem; neuter NOM.SG sweh₂dú required to agree with h₂mélǵos.
h₂yuHn̥ḱṓs Hyudʰsmṓys: INS.PL 'with warriors', but English 'the young warriors' needs NOM.PL Hyudʰsmṓs in apposition.
h₁íh₁ h₂m̥bʰí 'in exchange for him' – stretched use of h₂m̥bʰí with instrumental.
bʰgih₁tó: zero grade of bʰeh₂g- should keep the laryngeal (bʰh₂gih₁tó).
h₁suménesos suHnúbʰos lémbʰt 'seized the son of Kindly': suHnúbʰos is DAT/ABL.PL; ACC.SG suHnúm required.
